text: Rust has been the most loved language in the Stack Overflow Survey for 8 years running.
Git was created by Linus Torvalds in just 10 days, back in 2005.
The first documented software bug was, literally, a moth trapped in a relay, in 1947.
TypeScript was released by Microsoft in 2012 as a superset of JavaScript.
HTTP/3 runs on QUIC over UDP instead of TCP, for faster connections.
Regular expressions trace back to the finite automata described by Stephen Kleene in the 1950s.
Docker popularized containers, but Linux cgroups have existed since 2006.
Python was named after Monty Python, not the snake.
An SSD has no moving parts, which is why it's far more shock-resistant than an HDD.
The first commit to the Linux kernel was made by Linus Torvalds in 1991.
